scope.summary: Make the cloud-ci workspace-glob-coverage gate fail closed when the producer emits missing or empty rows.
explicit_non_claims: No branch-protection, workflow, root hub, Cargo, lockfile, or generated-policy file is changed.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited or included in the PR.
The separate BUCK-only gate-registration gap requires the shared .github/workflows/oya-ci-required.yml hot file and is reported as follow-up evidence only.
The ADR-0538 edit is an exact accounting-registration reference for this evidence packet, not a workflow or policy change.

facets.F1_correctness: evaluate_keyed now emits the registered crate_dir_not_covered code with <missing-rows> or <empty-rows> sentinel keys instead of returning an empty finding set.
facets.F2_tests: TDD red was observed for empty_corpus_is_red before the evaluator change; the focused Buck2 unit and live-corpus gate targets pass after the change.
facets.F3_maintainability: The change stays inside the existing pure evaluator and its local tests; no new dependencies or abstraction layers are introduced.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing row-level codes and covered/excluded crate behavior are unchanged; only broken producer feeds now become red.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, network calls, unsafe Rust, or runtime privileges are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: The gate evaluates repository workspace metadata only and does not process tenant, user, or personal data.
facets.F7_operability: The code surfaces stable <missing-rows> and <empty-rows> finding keys under the already-registered blocking code, so operators can distinguish producer failure from row-level workspace violations.
facets.F8_performance: The additional checks are constant-time guards before the existing row scan.
facets.F9_compliance: The evidence feed can no longer be silently absent while reporting green, improving auditability of the cloud-ci generated-artifact verification path.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of one evaluator/test change and this evidence packet.
facets.F11_observability: The live-corpus gate still prints row count, finding count, and verdict; the new code adds stable no-row sentinel keys for broken producer feeds.
facets.F13_migration: Strengthens Buck2/cloud-ci authority by preventing a missing generated face or producer regression from looking like a valid empty workspace.

buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/gates/oya-cloud-ci-workspace-glob-coverage-app:oya-cloud-ci-workspace-glob-coverage-app-gate -- PASS after local materialization
